scientific_integrity: Three standalone exact finite-state checking programs independently reconstruct the dynamics and spatial symmetries, reproduce 49 basin records, and agree on all 2048 states; external independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply only to the 11-vertex labelled Goldner–Harary graph and synchronous binary open-neighbor majority with tie retention; no infinite-family theorem, stochastic-network extrapolation, formal machine proof, or definitive historical priority is asserted.
title: Goldner–Harary majority dynamics: exact consensus dominance and seven oscillation symmetries
